products.title: Tiger Roar Relief Print
products.desc: The GOAT is now a piece of fine art. Made right here in-house at Matchstick, this linoleum reduction relief print shows Tiger Woods screaming in victory at the Masters. Complete with golf ball dimple accents across the shirt and hat, the multi-block reduction print was brought to life by local Portland artist Audrey Delgado. In a reduction print, each layer of colored ink is laid across a block to form pieces of the final piece. Then the linoleum block is hand-carved by the artist to create the next layer. That means the original block for this piece is now destroyed, and it can never be re-created. And because of the artist's hand registration, each piece is absolutely unique. This is a limited edition series of 15 prints complete with artist signature and sequential numbered edition. Details: Plate: Linoleum relief print, multi-block, reduction InK: Speedball block printing water-soluble ink Paper: pH neutral Japanese Masa paper Paper Size: 10" x 12" Print Size: 7.75" x 9" Total numbered editions: 15 Certificate of authenticity with serial number and date Framed and double matted

products.title: Golf: The Impossible Collection
products.desc: In this most recent addition to Assouline’s highly covetable and lauded Ultimate Collection, George Peper, former editor in chief of Golf magazine and 2016 PGA Lifetime Achievement Award winner for Journalism, takes readers on an incomparable golf journey as he travels the world detailing the 100 most significant, historically noteworthy, and architecturally paramount courses. Describing intricate holes that have confounded the game’s best, revisiting tournaments that have made and broken champions, and elucidating the unique and truly special characteristics of each course makes Peper the perfect golf partner as he walks readers through the clubhouses, fairways, and bunkers. From greens as old and hallowed as St Andrews to courses celebrating their first anniversary such as Nova Scotia’s Cabot Cliffs, from the island mountain course of China’s Shanqin Bay to the Hamptons’ Maidstone Club, Golf: The Impossible Collection is an unequivocal sensory treat for the golf fanatic, or the perfect feast to feed the wanderlust simmering in all of us. Complimentary white gloves and signature canvas tote bag are included with each purchase from Assouline's Ultimate Collection

products.title: Morocco: Kingdom of Golf
products.desc: Few places blend the spirit of golf with royal legacy quite like Morocco. The game’s roots in the Kingdom trace back to 1914, with the creation of the Royal Country Club of Tangier, the first golf course ever built in Morocco. Today, nearly fifty courses stretch across the country, attracting some of the best players in the world. Morocco: Kingdom of Golf was created to celebrate more than a century of golf, as well as the fiftieth anniversary of the Hassan II Golf Trophy. Established in 1971 by His Late Majesty King Hassan II, the tournament reflects his visionary commitment to developing golf throughout the nation. He collaborated with some of the world’s leading golf course designers, including Robert Trent Jones Sr. (who designed the magnificent Royal Golf Dar Es Salam) and Jack Nicklaus (the creator of Michlifen Golf & Country Club). In 1993, His Late Majesty also launched the Lalla Meryem Cup, a prestigious competition for top female professionals. Today, His Majesty King Mohammed VI has entrusted his brother, His Royal Highness Prince Moulay Rachid, to carry forward their father’s legacy, continuing to expand the sport, nurture new talent, and invest in Morocco’s golfing future. In May 2026, the Hassan II Golf Trophy will mark its milestone anniversary, celebrating not only a tournament but also the enduring passion and excellence of the game. Over the years, Steinbreder has made fifteen trips to Morocco and traveled throughout the Kingdom, making him the ideal person to recount this story, which also features original photography from Dutch photographer Ann Dokter.
